recommendations.title: Add 'object' field to all response structs
recommendations.description: All API responses include an 'object' field indicating the resource type (e.g., 'contact', 'topic', 'segment'). This field is missing from all response structs in the SDK.
recommendations.rationale: The 'object' field allows clients to verify the type of response received and is essential for proper API response handling. It enables type-safe deserialization and helps catch API version mismatches.
recommendations.suggestedImplementation: Add an 'Object string `json:"object"`' field to Contact, Topic, Segment, ContactProperty, Form, and all list response structs

recommendations.title: Fix Properties type for contacts
recommendations.description: The Properties field in CreateContactParams and UpdateContactParams uses map[string]string, but the API supports both string and number values.
recommendations.rationale: Users cannot set numeric custom properties (e.g., lifetime_value: 1000) with the current implementation. This limits the usefulness of custom contact properties.
recommendations.suggestedImplementation: Change Properties field type from map[string]string to map[string]interface{}

recommendations.title: Add missing Forms CRUD operations
recommendations.description: The Forms service is missing Update and Delete methods that exist in the OpenAPI spec.
recommendations.rationale: Users cannot update or delete forms through the SDK, limiting form management capabilities.
recommendations.suggestedImplementation: Add Update, UpdateWithContext, Delete, and DeleteWithContext methods to FormsSvc interface and implementation

recommendations.title: Add List API Keys endpoint
recommendations.description: The ApiKeys service only has Create but is missing List method from the OpenAPI spec.
recommendations.rationale: Users cannot retrieve existing API keys through the SDK.
recommendations.suggestedImplementation: Add List and ListWithContext methods to ApiKeysSvc

recommendations.title: Add typed constants for enum values
recommendations.description: Several fields use plain strings for values that are enums in the API (contact status, property type, topic visibility, form status).
recommendations.rationale: Typed constants provide compile-time safety and better IDE autocompletion for enum values.
recommendations.suggestedImplementation: Create type aliases and const blocks for ContactStatus, PropertyType, TopicVisibility, FormStatus

recommendations.title: Add godoc comments to all exported types and methods
recommendations.description: Ensure all public API has comprehensive documentation for godoc generation.
recommendations.rationale: Good documentation improves developer experience and reduces support burden.
recommendations.suggestedImplementation: Add // comments above each exported type, field, and method describing its purpose and usage
